records.description: Reductant tank temperature sensor circuit range/performance — the reported tank-temperature value is implausible compared with other engine temperature readings.
records.vehicle_scope: US17+ / OBD16 emissions and newer applications identified by the cited troubleshooting reference; confirm VIN, emissions generation, controller and calibration before applying.
records.source_title: Reductant Tank Temperature Sensor Troubleshooting Guide (UQLS), NHTSA manufacturer communication 10201715
records.caution: A stored inactive code alone does not establish a failed sensor. For an active/repeating code, use approved vehicle-specific diagnostics and verify connector condition, DEF quality and tank condition before condemning the combined DEF level/quality/temperature sensor. Do not treat this description as a complete repair procedure.
